title: Coordination Fake-Green Event v1
description: Records a detected enforcement test that passes but validates description text rather than implementation evidence. Content-light: uses file hashes, not raw paths or contents.

event_id.description: Deterministic event ID derived from content hash.

test_file_hash.description: Salted SHA256 hash of the test file path.

test_function.description: Name of the test function that is fake-green.

why_theatrical.description: Explanation of why the test is theatrical (passes without real enforcement).

what_would_still_pass_description.description: Description of what incorrect states the test would still pass through.

missing_adversarial_test_description.description: Description of what adversarial test coverage is missing.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.
